the approved [Scope Brief](../draft/SCOPE_BRIEF.md), and the preserved

## Remaining gates

Scientific approval is complete. The charter's fresh implementation-blind
post-owner consistency review must verify agreement between the two approved
views and their crosswalks before freeze. It must treat this approval as the
current disposition of the historical open proposals, without reopening the
science for style or stronger hypothetical capabilities.

Freeze must bind the approved brief, common sources, PDFs, crosswalk,
decision record, version/date, and exact file identities together. The
coefficient Registry and boundary admission, source promotion/binding,
canonical integration, and owner-held GitHub push remain subsequent explicit
operations. The separate scientific MAP/JINC grants above do not assert that
those operations have occurred or that any numerical route is available.

CTI-OD-002 remains open through those binding and admission gates. No
application implementation, default, additional coefficient family, NOI
permission, validation, performance, readiness, or production claim follows.
